bootstrap.aspect_agreement_fixed_grid: 4 models x 3 prompts x 6 temperatures x 3 seeds x 6 aspects

definitions.analysis_entropy_nats: -sum(p*ln(p)) after row-normalizing the stored screening u_p_* scores
definitions.binary_presence_analysis: Uses the archived raw-JSON present flag and does not derive presence from strength.
definitions.both_present_strength_analysis: Among schema-consistent entries for which both models marked the aspect present, compares weak versus clear exactly.
definitions.cooccurrence_pattern: the 15 pooled joint-positive rates among the six binary aspect-present fields
definitions.linear_weighted_kappa: Cohen's kappa with linear weights over none=0, weak=1, clear=2.
definitions.macro_pair_aspect_agreement: Equal mean of the 36 model-pair-by-aspect metrics.
definitions.matched_cross_llm_pair_agreement: mean of the six pairwise hard-label agreement indicators within the same item, prompt, temperature, and seed condition
definitions.micro_agreement: Metrics calculated after pooling contingency counts across the included pair-aspect cells.
definitions.multi_aspect: at least two of the six aspect-present fields are true
definitions.raw_valid_strength_analysis: Includes valid three-level strength strings regardless of agreement with the archived present flag.
definitions.released_category: canonicalized status from the released corpus
definitions.schema_consistent_strength_analysis: Includes valid strength strings only when present equals strength != none; entries are excluded rather than recoded.
definitions.screening_label: u_label from the full-corpus gpt-4o-mini screening annotation

limitations: The audit is a separately sampled subset of the same corpus, not an external validation dataset.
The sample was stratified only by screening-score entropy; label and disagreement composition were not quota controlled.
Rare-category summaries are descriptive because the 100-item sample contains few rare-label items.
The final output CSV has no explicit per-item parse-fallback flag, so a validation-failure rate cannot be reconstructed from this file alone.
Twenty-one invalid strength strings are excluded without semantic recoding.
The raw-valid strength analysis retains 96 valid strength/presence inconsistencies; the schema-consistent sensitivity analysis excludes them rather than reconciling them.
Item-cluster confidence intervals quantify item-sampling uncertainty conditional on the fixed models, prompts, temperatures, and seeds.
Model-pair rows share model ratings and do not support naive cell-level inference or generalization to unseen LLMs.
Cross-model correlations assess relative item ordering or co-occurrence structure; absolute entropy and aspect prevalence remain model dependent.

sampling.historical_sampling_statistic: -sum(s_k*log2(s_k)) applied directly to stored u_p_* scores without row normalization
sampling.note: Q2 is empty because the historical raw-score 25th and 50th percentile cut points are both zero. Manuscript-facing entropy summaries row-normalize scores first.
sampling.strategy: proportional strata from the historical raw-score dispersion statistic
